title: MaleTheme Duo #013 · 남 맨즈 피지크·아이돌 내추럴·천사 테마 / 남 V자 보디빌더·실버 포일·산타 테마
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunny seaside promenade of pale paving stones with a waist-high white railing, a lamp post and a row of normal-height beach huts, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Turkish man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a pretty androgynous idol face with large doe eyes, a small chin and a soft jaw, clean-shaven, natural idol makeup with soft brown eyeshadow and a tinted lip, fair olive skin with a warm undertone, a bright open smile showing his teeth, bold vivid magenta-pink hair styled in a classic French braid from the crown, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long brass chain ending in one large faceted amethyst drop, and on the other ear a large platinum hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on platinum chains of different lengths (a gold barrel-shaped weight, a silver cube-shaped block, a lead chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked platinum hair ornaments. Extremely long oval nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: An extraordinarily tall and large man, far beyond any real person, with a men's physique build. Enormously broad shoulders with round capped deltoids, a wide upper chest tapering sharply to a very narrow waist in a dramatic V-taper, a lean sharply defined six-pack abdomen with visible obliques, thick strong arms, and long lean athletic legs that are muscular but not bulky. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a thin golden halo floating above his head, a pair of large white feathered angel wings attached at his back, and a minimal white satin with gold trim T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his chest and stomach bare.
LEFT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of his body.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme cobalt-blue platform buckled boots, the platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Senegalese man in his early 30s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a delicate beautiful-boy face with long lashes, a slim straight nose and a clean jawline, clean-shaven, silver foil-lined eyes with a cool shimmer, deep blue-black skin with a smooth sheen, a gentle soft smile, soft strawberry-blonde hair styled in a sleek wet-look slicked straight back, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large gold hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (an iron miniature anvil, a tin chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a gold round bell, a gold ship's anchor, a gold barrel-shaped weight), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a single long copper chain ending in one large faceted ruby drop with a heavy rough silver a small flared temple bell hanging at its end, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten rose-gold anklets. Extremely long almond nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: An extraordinarily large and powerful man, far beyond any real person. A massive V-shaped torso: enormously broad shoulders with capped, rounded deltoids, a thick heavy chest, a deeply carved six-pack abdomen narrowing to a comparatively small waist, huge thick arms with split biceps and horseshoe triceps, wide flaring lats, and powerful thick quads and diamond calves. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a red velvet Santa hat with a white fur trim and pom-pom, white fur cuffs on both wrists, and a minimal red velvet with white fur trim T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his chest and stomach bare.
RIGHT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of his body.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme black cowboy boots with thick platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary sole.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
